verdict.rationale: BILL documents a REST v3 API that covers Spend & Expense, including managing transactions and reimbursements, and S&E calls use an apiToken. The pack never mentions OAuth or scoped tokens, and receipt retrieval is not shown; document uploads are documented only for bills, vendors, customers and invoices. missing for 10: OAuth authorization flow, scoped/permissioned tokens, documented receipt retrieval endpoints for S&E, explicit expense/transaction GET endpoints, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull transactions, expenses, and receipts through a documented REST API with OAuth and scoped tokens

citations.quote: The BILL v3 API follows the REST architecture. We use all the standard REST verbs (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE) and provide HTTP response codes.
